articles.title_en: Bayesian methods in economics and finance: A unified survey and taxonomy
Deviance Information Criterion for Bayesian model selection: Theoretical justification and applications
Likelihood specification in simultaneous equation models for discrete data
articles.title_cn: 离散数据的 simultaneousequation 模型中的似然性规范
articles.abstract_en: In this article, we examine the foundations of a rich and diverse literature in economics and derive the likelihood function of simultaneous equation models for discrete data as the invariant distribution of a suitably specified Markov process. This formulation offers a well-defined reduced form of the model and dispenses with the need for controversial recursivity requirements and ad hoc indeterminacy rules. The derivation resolves puzzling paradoxes highlighted in earlier work and shows that the likelihood is unique, proper, coherent, complete, and theoretically grounded in conditional distribution modeling – a framework that has yet to be popularized in economics. We note possible extensions and relevant links with other models, comment on computational issues, and implement the methodology in three empirical applications involving female labor force participation, the interactions between health and wealth, and the interplay between banks’ lending practices and their reliance on assistance from the lender of last resort during the Great Depression.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考察了经济学中丰富多样的文献基础，并推导出离散数据 simultaneousequation 模型的似然函数，作为适当指定的马尔可夫过程的不变分布。这种表述提供了模型的明确定义的简化形式，并消除了对有争议的递归要求和临时不确定性规则的需求。推导解决了早期工作中突出的问题悖论，并表明似然是唯一的、适当的、一致的、完整的，并在条件分布建模中理论上扎根——这一框架在经济学中尚未普及。我们注意到可能的扩展和与其他模型的相关联系，评论计算问题，并在 三 实证应用中实施该方法，涉及女性劳动参与、健康与财富之间的相互作用，以及银行贷款实践与在大萧条期间对最后贷款人援助的依赖之间的相互作用。

articles.title_en: Semiparametric Bayesian estimation in an ordinal probit model with application to life satisfaction across countries, age and gender
A Bayesian approach to modeling economic growth: Variable selection and cross-sectional dependence
Macro-prudential policy under asymmetric risks: A Bayesian structural quantile VAR approach
articles.title_cn: 不对称风险下的宏观审慎政策：一种贝叶斯结构量化VAR方法
articles.abstract_en: Macro-prudential policymakers face a risk-management problem: they must assess medium-term downside risks to the real economy stemming from financial imbalances and the associated threat of future financial crises, while accounting for the cost of policy interventions in terms of foregone upside potential. This trade-off between limiting downside risks and preserving upside growth is inherently asymmetric and depends on the distribution of future macroeconomic outcomes. We formalize this decision problem by defining novel measures of downside risk and upside potential and by stipulating an explicit loss function for macro-prudential policy. To evaluate policy in this setting, we develop and apply a novel Bayesian structural quantile vector autoregressive model that delivers flexible and potentially asymmetric predictive distributions. Using quantile impulse responses, we assess the scope for macro-prudential policy to reduce growth volatility and negative skewness, infer the macro-prudential policy stance, and characterize the circumstances under which macro-prudential interventions are likely to be beneficial.
articles.abstract_cn: 宏观审慎政策制定者面临风险管理问题：他们必须评估源于金融失衡的对实体经济的中期下行风险及未来金融危机的相关威胁，同时考虑政策干预在放弃上行潜力方面的成本。这种限制下行风险与保持上行增长之间的权衡本质上是非对称的，并且依赖于未来宏观经济结果的分布。我们通过定义新的下行风险和上行潜力的度量，并规定宏观审慎政策的明确损失函数，来形式化这一决策问题。为了在这一背景下评估政策，我们开发并应用了一种新的贝叶斯结构量化向量自回归模型，该模型提供灵活且可能是非对称的预测分布。通过量化脉冲响应，我们评估宏观审慎政策减少增长波动性和负偏度的潜力，推断宏观审慎政策立场，并描述宏观审慎干预可能带来益处的情境。

articles.title_en: Bayesian model comparison for large Bayesian VARs after the COVID-19 pandemic
Large Bayesian matrix autoregressions
articles.title_cn: 大型贝叶斯矩阵自回归
articles.abstract_en: High-dimensional matrix-valued time-series are increasingly common in economics and ﬁnance. Prominent examples include large cross-region panels and dynamic economic networks. As the dimensions of the matrix grow, conventional approaches based on vector autoregressions—implemented by vectoring the matrix-valued data— become computationally infeasible. We introduce a class of large Bayesian matrix autoregressions (MARs) that can accommodate time-varying volatility, non-Gaussian errors and COVID-19 outliers. To tackle parameter proliferation, we propose Minnesota-type shrinkage priors for these MARs. We develop a uniﬁed approach for estimating these models that scales well to high dimensions. The empirical relevance of these new MARs is illustrated using a US state-level dataset that contains 6 macroeconomic times-series for each of the 50 states, with a total of 300 times-series.
articles.abstract_cn: 高维矩阵值时间序列在经济学和金融学中越来越常见。突出的例子包括大型跨区域面板和动态经济网络。随着矩阵维数的增长，基于向量自回归的传统方法（通过对矩阵值数据进行向量化来实现）在计算上变得不可行。我们引入了一类大型贝叶斯矩阵自回归（MAR），它可以适应时变波动性、非高斯误差和 COVID-19 异常值。为了解决参数扩散问题，我们为这些 MAR 提出了明尼苏达型收缩先验。我们开发了一种统一的方法来估计这些模型，该方法可以很好地扩展到高维度。这些新 MAR 的经验相关性使用美国州级数据集进行说明，该数据集包含每个 6 州的 50 宏观经济时间序列，总共 300 个时间序列。

articles.title_en: Partial identification of structural vector autoregressions with non-centred stochastic volatility
articles.title_cn: 非中心随机波动下结构向量自回归的部分识别
articles.abstract_en: We consider structural vector autoregressions that are identified through stochastic volatility under Bayesian estimation. Three contributions emerge from our exercise. First, we show that a non-centred parameterization of stochastic volatility yields a marginal prior for the conditional variances of structural shocks that is centred on homoskedasticity, with strong shrinkage and heavy tails—unlike the common centred parameterization. This feature makes it well suited for assessing partial identification of any shock of interest. Second, Monte Carlo experiments on small and large systems indicate that the non-centred setup estimates structural parameters more precisely and normalizes conditional variances efficiently. Third, revisiting prominent fiscal structural vector autoregressions, we show how the non-centred approach identifies tax shocks that are consistent with estimates reported in the literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑通过贝叶斯估计在随机波动下识别的结构向量自回归。三 贡献源于我们的研究。第一，我们展示了随机波动的非中心参数化如何为结构冲击的条件方差提供一个以同方差性为中心的边际先验，具有强收缩性和重尾特征——这与常见的中心参数化不同。这一特征使其非常适合评估任何感兴趣冲击的部分识别。第二，小型和大型系统的蒙特卡洛实验表明，非中心设置能够更精确地估计结构参数，并有效地标准化条件方差。第三，重新审视显著的财政结构向量自回归，我们展示了非中心方法如何识别与文献中报告的估计一致的税收冲击。

articles.title_en: Text-term selection and analysis: Frequentist and Bayesian strategies and interpretations
articles.title_cn: 文本术语选择与分析：频率主义和贝叶斯策略及其解释
articles.abstract_en: Economic analysis based on text data has expanded rapidly, yet the ultra-high dimensionality of text data presents substantial challenges for term selection and estimation. We propose the Information-Adaptive Lasso and Information-Adaptive Spike-and-Slab Lasso as novel frequentist and Bayesian approaches to address these challenges. A key theoretical contribution of this study is the establishment of the rate of convergence in term-selection consistency, which we show to be faster than those achieved in the existing Lasso literature. Applying our methods to Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statements, we identify and estimate high-impact terms driving fluctuations in monetary policy uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于文本数据的经济分析迅速扩展，但文本数据的超高维度性给术语选择和估计带来了重大挑战。我们提出信息自适应Lasso和信息自适应Spike-and-Slab Lasso作为应对这些挑战的新颖频率主义和贝叶斯方法。本研究的一个关键理论贡献是建立术语选择一致性的收敛速度，我们证明其比现有Lasso文献中实现的速度更快。将我们的方法应用于联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）声明，我们识别并估计了驱动货币政策不确定性波动的高影响术语。

articles.title_en: Bayesian space–time varying coefficient modeling for climate econometrics: A spatial–temporal Gaussian process approach
Bayesian estimation of a semiparametric stochastic frontier model with persistent and transient inefficiencies
Model uncertainty in the cross-section of stock returns
Bayesian model averaging with non-conjugate priors
Concentrated MCMC estimation
Testing for differences in high-frequency network connectedness from variance decompositions
articles.title_cn: 通过方差分解测试高频网络连通性的差异
articles.abstract_en: We develop a Bayesian Wald-type test for detecting temporal differences in connectedness from variance decompositions, and establish the asymptotic normality of impulse response functions and variance decomposition matrices at fixed local time points. The resulting test statistic is asymptotically χ 2 distributed under the null hypothesis and performs well in Monte Carlo simulations. Applying our methodology to high-frequency options data on sectoral exchange-traded funds (ETFs) from January 2013 to June 2023, we identify and quantify monetary policy surprises following Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements. Our empirical results indicate that total connectedness among sectoral ETF implied volatilities increases significantly following FOMC announcements, with these elevated connectedness levels persisting for approximately one hour on days with monetary policy surprises. Our findings indicate more than one-fifth of FOMC announcements surprise financial markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了贝叶斯 Wald 型检验，用于检测方差分解中连通性的时间差异，并在固定的局部时间点建立脉冲响应函数和方差分解矩阵的渐近正态性。所得检验统计量在零假设下呈渐近分布 χ 2，并且在蒙特卡罗模拟中表现良好。将我们的方法应用于一月2013至六月2023期间部门交易所交易基金（ETF）的高频期权数据，我们识别并量化了联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）宣布后的货币政策意外。我们的实证结果表明，在 FOMC 公告发布后，部门 ETF 隐含波动率之间的总体关联性显着增加，并且在货币政策意外的日子里，这些关联性水平的升高会持续约 一 小时。我们的研究结果表明，超过 一-第五 次 FOMC 公告令金融市场感到惊讶。

articles.title_en: Stochastic volatility in mean: Efficient analysis by a generalized mixture sampler
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we consider the simulation-based Bayesian analysis of stochastic volatility in mean (SVM) models. Extending the highly efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo mixture sampler for the SV model proposed in Kim et al. (1998) and Omori et al. (2007), we develop an accurate approximation of the logarithm of the non-central chi-squared distribution as a mixture of thirty normal distributions . Under this mixture representation, we sample the parameters and latent volatilities in one block. We also detail a correction of the small approximation error by using additional Metropolis–Hastings steps. The proposed method is extended to the SVM model with leverage. The methodology and models are applied to excess holding yields and S&P500 returns in empirical studies, and the SVM models are shown to outperform other volatility models based on marginal likelihoods.

articles.title_en: A dynamic state-space HAR model
Bayesian evaluation of mutual fund performance with non-random missing data: Application to the Chinese market
A semiparametric Bayesian estimator of copula density
Bayesian nonparametric inference in bank business models with transient and persistent cost inefficiency
articles.title_cn: 具有瞬时和持久成本低效的银行商业模型的贝叶斯非参数推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel econometric framework for identifying and modeling bank business models (BBMs), which dynamically evolve in response to changing financial and economic conditions. Building on the stochastic frontier literature, we extend the traditional cost-efficiency models by decomposing inefficiency into persistent and transient components. We propose a Bayesian nonparametric approach that adapts to the data through an infinite mixture model with predictor-dependent clustering, enabling a flexible classification of banks into distinct business models. Our method, based on the Logit Stick-Breaking Process (LSBP), provides a data-driven way to capture the heterogeneity in bank strategies, allowing for dynamic transitions between business models over time. This model offers a significant advancement over existing parametric and kernel-based approaches by combining the scalability of nonparametric methods with efficient computational routines. We apply the model to a dataset of European banks and identify four distinct business model clusters, providing novel insights into the evolution of bank performance and efficiency. Our findings contribute to the growing literature on the identification and measurement of bank business models, offering valuable implications for policy and regulatory frameworks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种新颖的计量经济学框架，用于识别和建模银行商业模型（BBMs），这些模型会根据不断变化的金融和经济条件动态演变。在随机前沿文献的基础上，我们通过将低效分解为持久和瞬时成分，扩展了传统的成本效率模型。我们提出了一种贝叶斯非参数方法，该方法通过具有预测因子依赖聚类的无限混合模型适应数据，从而实现对银行进行灵活分类为不同商业模型。我们的方法基于Logit Stick-Breaking Process (LSBP)，提供了一种数据驱动的方式来捕捉银行战略的异质性，允许商业模型在时间上动态转变。该模型在结合非参数方法的可扩展性与高效计算程序方面，相较于现有的参数和基于核的方法提供了显著的进步。我们将该模型应用于一组欧洲银行的数据集，识别出四个不同的商业模型集群，为银行绩效和效率的演变提供了新颖的见解。我们的研究结果为银行商业模型的识别和测量的日益增长的文献做出了贡献，为政策和监管框架提供了有价值的启示。
